oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Ịdọ aka ná ntị: Gbanyụọ mmekọrịta oghere nwere ike imepụta ngwaahịa abụọ (omume e zubere).
Ịhapụ oghere hotbar ma ọ bụ ngwa ọ bụla n'emeghị mmekọrịta na-edobe ihe onye ọ bụla iche ma nwee ike ime ka ihe pụta ugboro abụọ mgbe ndị egwuregwu banyere, gbanwee otu, ma ọ bụ bugharịa ihe. Nke a bụ omume e zubere.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Achọpụtara uru njikọ na-ezighi ezi na config (> 100%% ma ọ bụ na-ezighi ezi); e weghachiri njikọ na 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Na-achịkwa ike e si ekesa mmetụta, ọgwụgwọ, nkwụghachi azụ, mmerụ ahụ, na Respiration. Na 100%%, ọnwụ ndị otu niile jikọtara; n'okpuru 100%% na-ekewapụ ọnwụ iwu (dịka na 50%%, mmerụ ahụ 10 nye A na-enye ndị otu 5). Anaghị emetụta oghere akpa e jikọtara.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.n: Mmerụ maka 1 obi otu: ọ dịghị (0%% njikọ)
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Na-egosi ole mmerụ ahụ otu onye ga-enweta (2 HP = 1 obi) ka ndị otu wee nweta 1 obi zuru ezu (2 HP) nke mmerụ ahụ e kekọrịtara.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Ọnụọgụgụ ike agụụ nke onye egwuregwu ọ bụla: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Ọnụọgụgụ inweta ahụmịhe nke onye egwuregwu ọ bụla: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. Imefu XP (enchantments, anvil) anaghị agbanwe.
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: Mgbe a gbanyere ya, a na-ekekọrịta oghere hotbar 9 niile (gụnyere aka isi gị) n'ime otu ahụ.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.tooltip: Mgbe njikọ Hotbar GBANYỤRỤ, na-ejikọ Oghere Hotbar 1 dị ka oghere aka isi e kekọrịtara.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.coupled_too: Ọ bụ Jikọọ Hotbar na-achịkwa ya mgbe njikọ Hotbar dị n'ọrụ (aka isi na-eji oghere hotbar a họọrọ).
oimr.settings.sync_off_hand.tooltip: Na-ejikọ oghere aka ọzọ n'etiti ndị otu niile.
oimr.settings.sync_helmet.tooltip: Na-ejikọ oghere okpu ígwè n'etiti ndị otu niile.
oimr.settings.sync_chestplate.tooltip: Na-ejikọ oghere uwe agha obi n'etiti ndị otu niile.
oimr.settings.sync_leggings.tooltip: Na-ejikọ oghere uwe ụkwụ agha n'etiti ndị otu niile.
oimr.settings.sync_boots.tooltip: Na-ejikọ oghere akpụkpọ ụkwụ agha n'etiti ndị otu niile.
oimr.settings.shared_knockback.tooltip: Na-ekesa nkwụghachi azụ n'ime otu (dabere na Njikọ) ma na-enye nkwụghachi azụ megidere mgbe a kụrụ onye otu.
oimr.settings.friendly_pets.tooltip: Na-egbochi anụmanụ ndị otu nwere ma ọ bụ tụkwasịrị obi ịwakpo ndị otu.
oimr.settings.exclude_creative.tooltip: Mgbe a gbanyere ya, a naghị egbu ndị otu nọ n'Ọnọdụ okike (Creative) site n'ọnwụ njikọ 100%%.
oimr.settings.wipe_creative.tooltip: Mgbe ndị otu Creative lanarịrị ọnwụ njikọ, ka hichaa akpa e kekọrịtara, ngwa, na XP.
oimr.settings.comunism.tooltip: Na-egosi ozi njakịrị mmekọrịta ọha mgbe otu ahụ nwụrụ n'agụụ.
oimr.settings.shared_ender_pearl.tooltip: Na-ebufe otu niile n'ebe ọ dara mgbe onye ọ bụla jiri Ender Ọla kwaga ebe ọzọ.
oimr.settings.shared_portals.tooltip: Na-ebufe otu niile ọnụ mgbe onye ọ bụla gafere Ọnụ Ụzọ Nether ma ọ bụ End.
oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Na-etinye nzacha ụda dị nro nke mmiri mgbe ọ bụla gị ma ọ bụ onye otu jikọtara nọ n'okpuru mmiri.
oimr.settings.shared_mob_sounds.tooltip: Na-emegharị ụda anụmanụ ndị otu nụrụ site na ohere 1/N (N = ọnụọgụgụ otu), ntụziaka chere anụmanụ ahụ, ebe dị anya dabara adaba, na olu dabere na Njikọ.
